Name: Lee
Text: This is the mission site.

Name: Lee
Text: Punishing concentration nearby is quite high. Let's proceed carefully.

Name: Lee
Text: I knew there'd be an ambush.

Name: Lee
Text: Strange, the mechanoids are attacking each other?

Name: Lee
Text: Looks like we need to investigate the downed mechanoid.

Name: Lee
Text: Mechanoid data collection complete, preparing to return.

Name: Rosetta
Text: I'm... I'm fine, 【kuroname】. I just need a moment to rest.

Name: Commandant
Text: Your wounds haven't worsened, Rosetta. But you're still seeing hallucinations, aren't you?

Name: Commandant
Text: The damage to your M.I.N.D. might be worsening. We'll have to wait until we get back to Babylonia to repair it.

Name: Rosetta
Text: Don't worry, they're just scratches. They won't get in the way of our evacuation plan.

Name: Rosetta
Text: The blizzard hasn't reached its worst yet. Come sit with me for a bit, 【kuroname】.

Name: Commandant
Text: Rosetta, let's go over the evacuation plan one more time.

Name: Rosetta
Text: We'll use the blizzard to cover us, outsmart the enemy, and complete the evacuation.

Name: Rosetta
Text: That's a bold plan, 【kuroname】... but I'm on board.

Name: Commandant
Text: The blizzard isn't fully on our side. We need to prepare for the worst-case scenario—getting separated.

Name: Rosetta
Text: If we get separated... don't try to find me. If you run into enemy patrols in the blizzard...

Name: Rosetta
Text: It's too risky... We need to head to the evacuation point separately. 【kuroname】, I know we'll meet there.

Name: Commandant
Text: Let's double-check the comms. If we get separated, at least we'll be able to stay in touch. Rosetta, can you hear me clearly?

Name: Rosetta
Text: It's very clear, and the connection's stable. It's like you're speaking right next to me, 【kuroname】.

Name: Commandant
Text: We've still got some time before we leave. Rosetta, get some rest and conserve your energy.

Name: Rosetta
Text: Yeah, you should rest too, 【kuroname】.

Name: Rosetta
Text: 【kuroname】... come closer... the blizzard is so fierce... please hold me tight...

Name: Rosetta
Text: 【kuroname】... so warm...

Name: Rosetta
Text: 【kuroname】, I think I just had a dream...

Name: Rosetta
Text: I'm sorry, 【kuroname】, what time is it now?

Name: Commandant
Text: Have you rested enough? The blizzard's picking up. It's the perfect time for us to head out.

Name: Commandant
Text: (Looks like Rosetta's injury is slowing her down. Gotta finish the evacuation quickly.)

Name: Commandant
Text: Come on, lean on me.

Name: Rosetta
Text: 【kuroname】... thank you.

Name: Rosetta
Text: If only... my thrusters hadn't been damaged...

Name: Commandant
Text: It's okay. We made it this far without the thrusters, didn't we?

Name: Commandant
Text: It's because we've been supporting each other that we've made it this far, right, Rosetta?

Name: Rosetta
Text: But... the blizzard's getting worse, and we've barely covered a quarter of our route...

Name: Rosetta
Text: This won't work. 【kuroname】, you need to go on ahead... I'll... I'll catch up with you later.

Name: Commandant
Text: What are you talking about? We're going back to Babylonia together. Just hang on a little longer, Rosetta.

Name: Commandant
Text: This is the final stretch. The evacuation point is just ahead.

Name: Rosetta
Text: Alright... I'll hang on. I'll make it to the evacuation point with you, 【kuroname】.

Name: Mechanoid A
Text: Footprints? Humans can't move fast in this blizzard. They're probably not far ahead.

Name: Rosetta
Text: Damn it, running into pursuers now... 【kuroname】, we...

Name: Commandant
Text: They haven't spotted us yet. Let's find cover and hide.

Name: Commandant
Text: This spot's well-hidden. We should be safe here.

Name: Rosetta
Text: ...【kuroname】, hurry and get in here.

Name: Commandant
Text: Wait here and stay quiet. I'll check the enemy's movements.

Name: Mechanoid A
Text: Footprints lead that way. Go search that area.

Name: Mechanoid B
Text: In this blizzard? How could humans possibly be out here...

Name: Mechanoid B
Text: Hm?

Name: Commandant
Text: Feeling nervous? It's okay. Go ahead and put your hand here.

Name: Commandant
Text: They're gone. That was too close. Let's keep moving.

Name: Rosetta
Text: 【kuroname】, I'm feeling better now. I can walk on my own from here.

Name: Rosetta
Text: Umm... my legs are numb from staying in that position...

Name: Commandant
Text: The wind's still too strong. Rosetta, get behind me. I'll shield you.

Name: Commandant
Text: Rosetta, you holding up okay? Want to take a break?

Name: Rosetta
Text: I'm fine... 【kuroname】, I can keep going. Let's move forward.

Name: Commandant
Text: Rosetta, feel that? The wind's letting up a bit.

Name: Commandant
Text: We're halfway there. Just a bit longer, and we'll reach the evacuation point.

Name: Commandant
Text: Rosetta, if you need to rest, just let me know.

Name: Commandant
Text: Shh...! I think there are enemies ahead.

Name: Commandant
Text: Hold up. I think there are enemies ahead.

Name: Kamui
Text: I'll never let the sun fall...

Name: Kamui
Text: This place is not gonna be the end of our journey!

Name: Abel
Text: There are just too many enemies. I really don't think I can go on...

Name: Kamui
Text: You can't stop here! Trust me, I'll definitely get you all outta here!

Name: Carol
Text: It's Kamui! Have you gotten stronger? Thank goodness, we're saved!

Name: Kamui
Text: You can count on me. I'll be your strength!

Name: Kamui
Text: Everyone, stay behind me. We'll rescue the others together.

Name: Kamui
Text: I'm sorry... we came too late.

Name: Darren
Text: Kamui... we're not going to make it... take the others and... go...

Name: Abel
Text: Kai! Hang in there!! We're coming to help you right away!

Name: Kai
Text: There are too many enemies! Forget about us! Take the energy source and go, now!!

Name: Kamui
Text: No! We're not leaving any of our family behind!

Name: Kamui
Text: C'mon! All of you, come at me all at once! I'll tear every last one of you to shreds!

Name: Azael
Text: Kamui, you've finally returned to our home...

Name: Kamui
Text: Yeah, and since you can't turn back now, I'll be the one to deliver your judgment.

Name: Kamui
Text: Why would you do this?! How could you hurt them like that?!

Name: Azael
Text: I only released them from their suffering. Because of me, our family will never be apart!

Name: Azael
Text: And now, you're the only one left, Kamui!

Name: Azael
Text: Traitor! You're the one who forgot about us, you're the one who abandoned us!

Name: Kamui
Text: What're you talking about?! YOU'RE the one who betrayed everyone!

Name: Azael
Text: Is that all you've got?

Name: Azael
Text: Go on, why'd you stop?

Name: Azael
Text: Too slow!

Name: Azael
Text: Fool! You fell for it!

Name: Azael
Text: Tsk.

Name: Azael
Text: That's enough!

Name: Azael
Text: Worthless!

Name: Azael
Text: I remember, of course. You always loved this move.

Name: Azael
Text: I know you too well. You can't beat me.

Name: Azael
Text: Heh... this move? You taught me this one years ago.

Name: Azael
Text: Not bad, you've improved! Now let's get serious!

Name: Azael
Text: Watch closely, Kamui. I will only show you once.

Name: Azael
Text: Face your execution, traitor!

Name: Kamui
Text: Their wish was never to be imprisoned in your cage!
Commandant, the flowers are for you.
Commandant, the flowers are for you.
Director, we're ready.
Director, we're ready.

Name: Ellen
Text: I'm not entirely sure either, but we're going to improvise now!

Name: Ellen
Text: I'm not entirely sure either, but we're going to improvise now!

Name: Ellen
Text: This is the moment I've been waiting for... Action!

Name: Ellen
Text: This is the moment I've been waiting for... Action!
I remembered the original script, Commandant.

In the end, Helena missed Raven at the train station.

She never responded to him because she didn't understand her own feelings.

Even now, I still don't fully understand these feelings. The ability to feel affection was taken from me, but it seems I'm starting to rediscover it anew.

These emotions I feel when I'm with you... I can't put them into words. Maybe I've never felt them before.
These emotions I feel when I'm with you... I can't put them into words. Maybe I've never felt them before.
You make me feel comfort, and you make me feel sorrow.
You make me feel comfort, and you make me feel sorrow.
I want to be close to you. I want to hold you. And I... I panicked when I saw you with Ellen.
I want to be close to you. I want to hold you. And I... I panicked when I saw you with Ellen.
I'm afraid that I'll lose you if I don't understand these feelings in time.
I'm afraid that I'll lose you if I don't understand these feelings in time.
That's why I wanted to take you for myself.
That's why I wanted to take you for myself.
Commandant, give me your hand.
Commandant, give me your hand.
My face... it's burning, isn't it?
My face... it's burning, isn't it?
The script said that when someone you love touches your face, it gets warm.
The script said that when someone you love touches your face, it gets warm.
Doesn't this prove that I love you, Commandant?
Doesn't this prove that I love you, Commandant?
I get it now, Commandant.
I get it now, Commandant.
Because of you, I've come to know this feeling called love... something I'd never experienced before.
Because of you, I've come to know this feeling called love... something I'd never experienced before.
It's not because looking into your eyes comforts me that I love you.
It's not because looking into your eyes comforts me that I love you.
It's not because I feel warm when you touch me that I love you.
It's not because I feel warm when you touch me that I love you.
It's not because I'm afraid of losing you that I love you.
It's not because I'm afraid of losing you that I love you.
Rather, it's because I love you that all those feelings exist in the first place.

Commandant... will you accept my feelings?
Commandant... will you accept my feelings?
I... said a lot just now...
I... said a lot just now...
I'm so tired...
I'm so tired...

Name: Facility Broadcast
Text: You have arrived at the Engineering Zone, Lower Level.

Name: Adelyde
Text: We're getting close to the Sefirah Engine. The spacetime anomalies could get a lot worse from here. Stay sharp.

Name: Adelyde
Text: There's another Ananke unit over there. Use it to fix the road ahead.

Name: Adelyde
Text: Obstacle cleared. Huhu, lead the way.

Name: Adelyde
Text: We're out of range of the last Ananke unit. Let's find the nearest one.

Name: Adelyde
Text: This way's blocked. Let's find somewhere to drop down.

Name: Adelyde
Text: Hmph. Out of my way.

Name: Adelyde
Text: Done. It's okay, Huhu. Don't be afraid.

Name: Adelyde
Text: Door's stuck? That's nothing. Stand back. I'll handle it.

Name: Facility Broadcast
Text: High-power weaponry is prohibited beyond this point. Initiating anti-explosion security protocols.

Name: Adelyde
Text: It's been so long since I was last here that I forgot about this... Time is of the essence. We'll fight our way through.

Name: Adelyde
Text: Behind that door is the Sefirah Engine, the true heart of the Atlantic Eye.

Name: Adelyde
Text: It's dangerous in there. The commandant and I will handle it. You should head back up and help the other teams.

Name: Adelyde
Text: Thank you. Take care of yourself.

Name: Rusalka
Text: Look at this broken world. What does the TEC or humanity have left to hold us back?

Name: Rusalka
Text: I clawed my way back from hell. I won't make the same mistake twice.

Name: Rusalka
Text: Stop wasting your time on rotten wood. Get over here.

Name: Adelyde
Text: I'm not here to join you. I'm here... to stop you!

Name: Rusalka
Text: Stalling won't get you anywhere.
诘问与诀别\n直面今昔\n大西洋之眼 质点发动机

Name: Rusalka
Text: 阿德莱德，你清楚与我为敌的下场。

Name: Rusalka
Text: 赫里欧家族巡洋猎锋·露莎卡，命令你交出质点，否则，沦为猎物!

Name: Adelyde
Text: 绝不。我的老师，没教过我不战而退。

Name: Rusalka
Text: 准头欠佳，该我了。

Name: Rusalka
Text: 力道不够，必遭反扑。

Name: Rusalka
Text: 锋刃绞杀!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 起，爆!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 就这点能耐?

Name: Adelyde
Text: 逸散的能量在聚拢——不能任由她回收!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 教你的都还给我了。

Name: Rusalka
Text: 动作太慢!

Name: Rusalka
Text: Hmm...

Name: Rusalka
Text: 竟然，呃!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 接好!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 弱者的信念，就是废话!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 刚才拦我的劲头呢?

Name: Rusalka
Text: 复兴需要代价，哪怕是你，哪怕是我!

Name: Adelyde
Text: 咳，机体好重……必须抢取能量，冲破压制!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 那群懦夫，活着就是对赫里欧姓氏的侮辱。反而是你和我，一个叛徒，一个死人，还配得上它。

Name: Adelyde
Text: 还差一点……只差一点!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 你就非要，自讨苦吃!

Name: Rusalka
Text: “理解”……仅仅迈出半步，我就挣开了人类蹉跎千万年的囚笼，岂会……就此回去!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 放肆够了?

Name: Rusalka
Text: 疾雷，做我的猎手!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 朽木易折……

Name: Rusalka
Text: 赢到最后，才算数。

Name: Rusalka
Text: 还能站着，难得。

Name: Rusalka
Text: 大西洋之眼啊，释放你激荡的威能，为我鞭策命运!

Name: Adelyde
Text: 难道亚利乌斯不光荼毒心志，还腐蚀了你的技巧?

Name: Rusalka
Text: 筛选追猎我们所有人，你，别无选择!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 该结束了!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 千里一瞬。

Name: Rusalka
Text: 为了力量，我可以献出一切。

Name: Rusalka
Text: 在湮灭中，重塑未来!

Name: Rusalka
Text: 我倾尽了所有……我不……后悔……
